blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines, September 29, 2026 — GCash is making Retail Treasury Bond 32 (RTB 32) available through GBonds, powered by Philippine Digital Asset Exchange (PDAX), Inc. and PDAX Securities, in partnership with the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr). This offering gives eligible users a convenient way to invest in a bond issued by the Republic of the Philippines, starting at ₱5,000. The primary offer runs from September 29 to October 7, unless the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr) closes it earlier. RTB 32 has a 2.5-year term, will be issued on October 12, 2026 and will mature on April 12, 2029. […]...
